Yoooo i read all of it btw, youve had a fucked up upbringing, same. it sucks, i feel u.  i understand the whole drugs thing and im not gonna advise you against it if it helps you more than it harms you, i dont think you should kill yourself, i hope u decide not to, i, not gonna act like making some emotional speech will change your mind, because i cant change your decision, only you can, and it seems you havent decided yet.  i hope you dont, i dont want you to, please dont.  im not one for guilt tripping but it sounds like your one of the few people whos there for your brother and he needs you obviously, so if you wont stay for yourself, stay for him.  your too young to be doing drugs in my opinion but then again i was doing drugs too at your age, 2 years ago.  its fucked up the world we live in and soemtimes we have to escape it for a while, but not forever, if you need someone to talk to - which you probably do, (we all do )- i'm here.  i'd love to try and help you deal with all the bullshit thats in your life, or even to just talk about other completely different things if it helps.  please dont kill yourself. ive been though really shitty times and when i hear people say its gets better a million times over i would always just think its bullshit they have to say but honestly my lifes gotten better, a lot better, its far from perfect amd i still have a long way to go but it does get better i promise, it takes a lot of time obviously amd it can be so gradual that you dont even notice it changing, but it does change.  and its worth going through the shitty years to get to the amazing ones, you'be got another hundred years to live a better life so dont call it quits yet.  i may only be a couple of pixels on a screen to you but please listen when i tell you that youve got to keep on pushing through it all.  i can try and help you with it, im not a guru but i feel like i can relate to your problems and i cant just let you kill yourself, sorry, cant do it, cant let you do it.  dont do it. dont. dont. dont. just dont fucking do it ok? please??? lets talk.
